params.name: id
params.description: The batch ID returned from the initiating bulk operation

items.docs: Returns the current progress of a batch operation. Poll this endpoint until `status` is `completed`. When completed, a `results_url` is included. If all tasks failed, an `error` field is included with the failure reason.

params.name: id
params.description: The batch ID returned from the initiating bulk operation

items.docs: Returns the per-task results for a batch operation. Call this endpoint after polling `/progress` until `status` is `completed`. Each entry in `results` corresponds to one task, with the task outcome in `result` and any error message in `message`.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by batch status. `processing` returns in-progress batches; `completed` returns finished batches.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Return only batches last modified at or after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`).

params.name: date_from_utc
params.description: UTC filter. Accepts ISO 8601 with optional Z/offset, or YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS] (assumed UTC). Takes precedence over the non-_utc variant.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Return only batches last modified at or before this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. `2024-12-31T23:59:59Z`).

params.name: date_to_utc
params.description: UTC filter. Accepts ISO 8601 with optional Z/offset, or YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS] (assumed UTC). Takes precedence over the non-_utc variant.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of batch jobs belonging to the authenticated user, sorted by last modified time descending. Use the `status` filter to narrow results to in-progress or completed batches. Use `date_from` / `date_to` to filter by last modified time range.
